snippet.title: Hollow Bequest - Intro Cutscene
snippet.description:
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2591960/Hollow_Bequest/

Note: This is not official trailer it is intro cutscene.

As a legendary detective, disappearance of a former mentor provokes a return to yours humble beginnings. Every clue reveals the dark secrets that haunt the town. What should have been a quick investigation, gradually turned into struggle for your own life and freedom Who or what is responsible?
